message: I have this friend, bless her heart, who turns into a tornado of panic at the first hint of bad weather. The other day she called me, breathless, about a winter storm warning. I told her to take a deep breath, maybe bake some cookies and stock up on hot cocoa instead of running around like her hair was on fire. Sometimes, a little calm can go a long way in a storm. What’s your go-to comfort during stormy weather? ☕
